name: Production Status Report
purpose: Summarize progress, blockers, approvals, cost, quality and next critical work.
scope: Bounded studio_governance capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for production_status_report.
Execute the bounded operation: Summarize progress, blockers, approvals, cost, quality and next critical work.
Apply production_status_report-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to production_librarian.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run production_status_report on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask production_status_report to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
